en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a riverside town with a large historic building complex on a wooded hill to the left and a church with a tall tower near the center. Small houses line the riverbank. A paddle steamer crowded with people sails along the river, with another smaller vessel behind it. Trees frame the foreground. In the lower left corner, text reads 'Pirna a.d. Elbe'.
